# Fennec Dash - All-in-One Business Platform
> CRM · ERP · CMS · MAP · PIM (21 integrated modules)

Fennec Dash is a comprehensive business management platform for the Algerian and international market. Self-hosted, one-time license purchase, compliant with Law 18-07.

## Key Entities

- Fennec Dash (Product): Business application platform with 21 modules
- Fennec Vision: The publisher / development company
- Modules: Purchase, E-Invoice, Accounting, Exports, Goals, Logistic, Manufacturing, Warehouse, Warranty Management, HR Profile, Surveys, Quick Share, Report Builder, Backup, Menu Setup, Theme Style, AI Integration, Real Estate, Meta Leads, Fleet Management, Marketing Management
- Compliance: Law 18-07 (Algerian data sovereignty), ISO/IEC 27001, ISO 9001, GDPR
- Stack: PHP 8, MySQL, CodeIgniter 3

## Features
- Self-hosted, on-premise deployment
- One-time license fee, no subscriptions
- Light and dark adaptive themes
- 24/7 support, direct developer access
- Fully customizable UI
